# External research for v7 (retrieved 2026-11-12; information cutoff 2026-06-30 KST)

Rules used here: "pub date" is the date printed on the page (or the web-archive capture date when the page prints none).
"<= cutoff" = yes only if that date is on or before 2026-06-30. Live pages with no printed date are marked "undated".
Dates not confirmed by a fetched source are marked "not verified". Outcomes after the cutoff are listed separately and must not be used.

---

| 2023 daily hours | opens 16:00 weekdays, 14:00 weekends; fireworks 21:00, EDM party 22:00 (closing time not verified) | https://www.tourtoctoc.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=1667 ; Newsis link above | 2023-08-14 ; 2023-08-04 | yes |

| Earlier organiser notice | call for an operating company for the "16th 2026 송도맥주축제"; page text and poster carry no festival dates; the two attachments (hwp/hwpx) were not opened | https://www.ifm.kr/article/81876 | 2026-01-26 | yes (but dates not verified in it) |

**Earliest dated announcement of the 2026 date range: 경인방송 news article, 2026-06-23 13:45 KST (7 days before the cutoff).**
The sentence gives the dates as: "오는 8월 22일부터 30일까지 9일간 송도달빛축제공원에서" (source: 경인방송, URL in the table).
So the 2026 date range WAS publicly announced on or before 2026-06-30.

Calendar note (derived, not from a source): 2023-2025 editions ran Friday to the Saturday of the following week; 2026 runs Saturday to
the Sunday of the following week (two full weekends: 08-22/23 and 08-29/30, weekdays 08-24 to 08-28).

**Confidence and gaps.** Dates for 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 are high confidence (organiser page plus news). The 2026 pre-cutoff
announcement is confirmed by two organiser-outlet articles (06-23 and 06-25); no earlier article stating the dates was found, and the
official site still showed "Coming Soon" on 06-10. The 2026-01-26 organiser notice may contain planned dates in its attachments, which I did
not open, so an earlier date than 06-23 is possible but not verified. Daily hours are the weak point: 2023 opening times are from a dated
travel article, 2024 and 2025 hours come from undated third-party listings, and closing times differ between sources (22:00 vs 22:20).
No pre-cutoff source gives the 2026 daily hours or the admission policy (the 06-23 and 06-25 articles say ticket details will follow).

**Confidence and gaps.** The dates themselves are high confidence (official page). What is not verified is WHEN the 2026 calendar was
first published: the page is undated. First-semester and summer-session 2026 dates are corroborated by dated pre-cutoff material
(02-02 notice, 05-06 notice, 06-14 archive capture). Second-semester 2026 dates (09-01 start, December exams) appear only on the live
page; the March 2026 minutes show the annual plan already existed, so pre-cutoff publication is very likely but not directly proven.
Midterm weeks and explicit vacation dates are not listed anywhere on the calendar.

2026 = 856 (Feb), 1,153 (Apr), 625 (Jun), 2,190 (Jul), 1,834 (Oct, planned). Identified 2026 Geomdan total 6,658.

**Confidence and gaps.** 2025-04, 2025-09, 2025-11 and 2026-02 to 2026-07 are high confidence (dated Zigbang releases published the
month before). 2025-01 and 2025-06 rest on blog lists that cite 청약홈, not on a dated release. August-December 2026 is plan-level only:
the two October complexes come from an LH notice and a 2024 sales article, and "none identified" months come from a blog list, so smaller
or public-rental complexes could be missing. Zigbang's Seo-gu 2026 total (9,734) exceeds what I can name by roughly 900 households after
adding the non-Geomdan complexes (루원 801, 연희 1,370), so at least one Seo-gu complex is unidentified. Public rental housing
(LH 국민임대/행복주택) is generally not itemised in these releases. Move-in "month" is the start of the move-in period; actual occupancy
spreads over the following 2-3 months. Mapping of each complex to a specific station is from names only; block-level distances are not verified.
The complex-level government file (부동산원/R114, 2026-02-27) was not opened and would be the best single cross-check.
